packageRules.description: Patches and dev-only minors carry the least risk and the most noise, so they arrive as one PR rather than twenty.
Types packages track the runtime they describe; separating them from it produces PRs that cannot pass on their own.
The three frameworks this repository is actually built on. Each gets its own PR, because reading the migration notes is the work and a grouped PR hides which one needs it.
Turbo, ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript and the test runners move together often enough that separate PRs mostly conflict with each other.
A major is never automerged, whatever else matched it.
